_source: Rise Coaching with Brenna, client programme for Jessie Peters (JESSIE_PETERS.docx). Source of truth: do not add exercises, weights or calorie targets that are not here.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled 3-sec negatives with 1-sec pause at contraction

exercises.name: RDL
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled maintaining proper form, watch yourself in the mirror - send me a video of form if you're concerned. Neutral spine, do not arch back, keep weights held in running along your legs, don't drop weight past your kneecaps

exercises.name: Leg extensions
exercises.cues: 3-sec negative and 2-sec pause at top

exercises.name: Walking Lunges with dumbbells
exercises.cues: Full range with big steps and controlled movement going up and down, hold dumbbells at your sides

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.cues: Straight back, don't drop your hips or have them too high, squeeze belly button

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cues: Leaning back engage your core, squeeze your armpits, pull bar down to chest, full stretch to the top

exercises.name: Seated Cable row
exercises.cues: Full stretch forward, drive elbows back down near hips, squeeze shoulder blades together at contraction

exercises.name: Hammer curl with dumbbells
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, keep elbows locked into place at your side, don't swing your arms

exercises.name: Tricep pushdown on cable
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, keep elbows locked into place at your side

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raises
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, will be pretty light because of rep range. Don't swing your arms or use the momentum. Going out at a 45-degree angle, you're holding the dumbbells but think of pulling them up from your elbows to focus on shoulders

days.title: Active rest
guidance: Still hitting step goal so taking morning/evening walks, walks after meals, etc.
Any tightness or soreness? Walking will help, stretch, use a roller, light yoga, etc.
Journaling, meal prep - anything you need to do to reflect on your progress and to plan ahead for tomorrow

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.cues: No heel elevation here unless you find it is better for your form. Heavy but controlled.

exercises.name: Hamstring curl
exercises.cues: Big squeeze at contraction, 3-sec negative

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat with dumbbells
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, stretch all the way down knee to floor without resting it

exercises.name: Cable crunches
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, 1-sec pause at contraction, slow to stretch, keep core engaged whole time

exercises.name: Lying Leg raises
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, don't let feet touch the ground in between

exercises.name: Shoulder press
exercises.cues: Elbows out at 45 degrees, bring elbows down just past shoulder height, slow on the way down

exercises.name: Chest press
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled

exercises.name: Overhead tricep extensions
exercises.cues: Set cable halfway height, step away, ears tucked between arms, pulling forward above head

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck (rear delts)
exercises.cues: Don't need to bring arms all the way behind you, think about squeezing shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.cues: Slow and controlled, tight core

options: Yoga or pilates if you enjoy
Swim, sports with the kids, etc.

steps.note: Wear watch if you can or keep phone on you to track.

hydrationLitres.note: Track with the same water bottle.

nutrition.note: Not tracking food or calories. Eat around maintenance (if not more). The old 1700 kcal number is dropped: never show it.
